theme: The last dry-land window before Croatia.
greeting: Two days from Tuesday's flight to Dubrovnik, with just the one short review on the calendar — the open hours are the last dry-land runway for the pre-departure bookings. The girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags are on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on Eurowings Discover. Pull it up on the operating carrier's site with the record locator, confirm the allowance there, and buy bags online before Tuesday — two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on and counter fees run far higher.

needsAttention.title: Book the Cavtat night and the marina transfer
needsAttention.detail: The single night of Sept 19 after the charter and the Komolac → Cavtat transfer still aren't booked. Onboard connectivity is poor, so both have to be locked from dry land before you fly.

needsAttention.title: Book the St Pete landing-gap nights
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20–22 has no lodging — you land TPA from Croatia on the 20th and the kids aren't picked up until Tuesday the 22nd, so you need two nights near St Pete before the Orlando drive.

needsAttention.title: Settle the Sept 20–Oct 5 rental hedge
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow is the decision point: book the refundable Full Size SUV backup unless Mike's car is confirmed en route with a written delivery window. Deciding it here beats finding out jet-lagged at a Sunday airport counter.

needsAttention.title: Call Halloween — St Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: Due Sept 5 and now a day past. The Oct 18–Nov 1 St Pete Airbnb and car both cover Halloween and the rotation booking fires while you're away, so a call before Tuesday keeps three downstream items from drifting.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike
schedule.detail: The weekly 15-minute board sweep — owners and dates on everything.

flagged.title: Andrew Kaufmann wants to reconnect
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn InMail this morning after a bounced email — he's checking whether you're still at KPMG and hoping to pick the thread back up. A short reply before the trip keeps the networking line warm.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and Labor Day sales — NYT Cooking, WSJ, Bloomberg, Foreign Affairs, and retail promos.

resolved.title: UN PRI call with Conor Kehoe
resolved.detail: You asked to push it past the trip; Kate confirmed Sept 4 she's holding the diary until you're back — nothing owed now.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash, yukon gold potatoes & cipolline
recipe.why: Early autumn brings in winter squash and sweet cipolline onions — a roast that leans into the season's first cool edges.

tasks.title: Confirm Nautilus boarding time and arrange the return transfer
Finish the Nautilus Masterclass videos (~68% done)
Pack the travel larder bin before the Sept 8 handoff
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: The 15-minute Sunday review with Mike is already behind you — the board's swept for the week.
Nothing else is on the calendar; the afternoon runs open all the way through.
A quiet evening at the St Pete house with the girls, two days out from the flight.
